about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Carlos A. Gimenez

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ONE-STOP PILOT PROGRAM EXTENSION ACT
statements.title: ONE-STOP PILOT PROGRAM EXTENSION ACT
sentences: Customs and Border Protection retains full oversight, and any passenger or bag identified as a security concern receives additional inspection.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of my bipartisan One-Stop Pilot Program Extension Act.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support the One-Stop Pilot Program Extension Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT, PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(c) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION, TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM HOSTILITIES WITH PRESIDENTIALLY DESIGNATED
statements.title: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT, PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(c) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION, TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM HOSTILITIES WITH PRESIDENTIALLY DESIGNATED TERRORIST ORGANIZATIONS IN THE...
sentences: Meanwhile, since 2021--I am not talking about 2001--nearly 400,000 Americans have died from overdose poisoning, deaths fueled by foreign terrorist organizations including the Venezuelan regime and violent cartels operating in our own backyard.
It tells terrorists and cartels that the United States Congress is willing to tie the hands of our Commander in Chief while they ship poison into our communities and profit from American death.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong opposition to H. Con. Res. 61.

We must reject this resolution and make clear to the world that the United States has the will to confront narcoterrorism head-on and that we will never surrender to the very people who are killing our children.
For the sake of our national security, our communities, and the men and women in uniform who stand the line every single day, I urge a ``no'' vote on this resolution.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: REMOVAL OF THE USE OF UNITED STATES FORCES FOR HOSTILITIES WITHIN OR AGAINST VENEZUELA
statements.title: REMOVAL OF THE USE OF UNITED STATES FORCES FOR HOSTILITIES WITHIN OR AGAINST VENEZUELA
sentences: This resolution would prohibit the use of United States Armed Forces off the coast of Venezuela without regard for the real and growing threats posed by the foreign terrorist Maduro regime.

The Maduro regime is a designated foreign terrorist organization, a narcoterrorist state that collaborates with other foreign terrorist organizations and violent cartels to flood our hemisphere and our communities with deadly poison.
Venezuela has been taken over.
This resolution would have us pull back from the fight against designated terrorist regimes and cartels in our own hemisphere, just miles from our shores.
It tells the foreign terrorist regime in Venezuela and its criminal allies that Congress is willing to look the other way as hundreds of thousands of Americans continue to die every single year.

We must reject this resolution and send a clear message: The United States will confront narcoterrorist regimes in our hemisphere, stand with the Venezuelan people, and never surrender to terrorist regimes that threaten our security.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong opposition to this resolution.
For the sake of our national security, our communities, and the men and women in uniform who stand the line every day, I urge a ``no'' vote on this resolution.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY VEHICULAR TERRORISM PREVENTION AND MITIGATION ACT OF 2025
statements.title: DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY VEHICULAR TERRORISM PREVENTION AND MITIGATION ACT OF 2025
sentences: It mandates a comprehensive assessment of current and emerging tactics, including the potential misuse of autonomous vehicles, rideshare platforms, and connected vehicle technologies.

Further, the bill strengthens coordination between Federal, State, and local governments and the private sector to better safeguard public gatherings, critical infrastructure, and high-density urban areas.
Madam Speaker, I rise today in strong support of my bill, H.R. 1608, the Department of Homeland Security Vehicular Terrorism Prevention and Mitigation Act of 2025.
Madam Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support H.R. 1608.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MICCOSUKEE RESERVED AREA AMENDMENTS ACT
statements.title: MICCOSUKEE RESERVED AREA AMENDMENTS ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of my bill, H.R. 504, the Miccosukee Reserved Area Amendments Act.
I urge my colleagues to join me in supporting H.R. 504.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DECOUPLING FROM FOREIGN ADVERSARIAL BATTERY DEPENDENCE ACT
statements.title: DECOUPLING FROM FOREIGN ADVERSARIAL BATTERY DEPENDENCE ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of H.R. 1166, the Decoupling from Foreign Adversarial Battery Dependence Act.
Mr. Speaker, I urge all of my colleagues to vote ``yes.''
